item.title: Brandon Boswell Year in Review
item.description: His 2022 Year in review Something about this spoke to me when I saw it. As time goes on you’ll forget much of a year. I like the idea of aggregating at multiple levels.

item.title: Good example of book with spaced repitition
item.description: This article does the same thing that quantum country does to improve the retention. Though to a lesser extent in the long term tracking of it.

item.title: Developing taste is the first step of mastery
item.description: Intro Mastery may not be the right word - virtuoso - perhaps a better term. But leaving that aside. To become great you need a couple of things. Where you are, an idea of where to go, and a way to measure whether you got closer or further from the goal.

item.title: Writing combats ignorance of your own knowledge
item.description: Overestimation of current knowledge is my greatest threat in my learning. When I go to learn a skill I find that Developing taste is the first step of mastery, this is very apparent with concrete application based skills.

item.title: Difficulty Curves and video games
item.description: Don’t just have a linear increasing curve, exponential curves are good for easy enter high mastery outcomes that lends itself to competitive games. People become desensitized to stimuli over time so an ever increasing difficulty will no longer get the response your looking for they will get bored or frustrated.

item.title: 2025-09-03 game rounds and real time
item.description: Summary I want to either move away from the real time ticking clock or move to make more rounds. I think I need to remove real time first so I can start figuring out this game design space.

item.description: Summary This morning I’m going to implement some quality of life on the rounds. I don’t know that this is the most useful things to work on though it still doesn’t feel like a game.

item.title: 2025-08-25 Goals
item.description: Right now the game is lacking in objective or force pushing you forward. I think the economy of unlocks would be good. Adding the ability to pick between some options and unlock them.
